standards.A. Residential and Apartment Districts (: A six-foot high screening wall or fence of other than chain-link shall be constructed around the base of a PWSF antenna support structure to provide for security. The gate which provides access to the PWSF antenna support structure shall remain locked at all times except when being used for access by maintenance personnel.
